_note: The Agniveer's own subscription: "An assessee, being an individual who has enrolled in the Agnipath Scheme and subscribes to the Agniveer Corpus Fund on or after the 1st November, 2022, shall be allowed a deduction in the computation of his total income, of the whole of the amount paid or deposited in his account in the said Fund during the tax year" (s.125(1), p.161) — the whole amount, base AMOUNT_PAID; enrolment and the date are entry conditions. Old regime only: s.202(2)(a)(xii) keeps s.125(2), not (1) (p.227). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26; the 1961 counterpart, s.80CCH, is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d5). rulebook DED-AGNIVEER-001. D-140. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80CCH(1) as inserted by FA 2023 s.39 (p.30): an individual enrolled in the Agnipath Scheme and subscribing to the Agniveer Corpus Fund on or after 1-11-2022, "the whole of the amount so paid or deposited"; old regime only — s.115BAC(2)(i) keeps 80CCH(2), not (1). The same row. sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md M12, M14. D-148.
